body:
Hey again everyone. Time to announce the winners of our Shrine contest, and one quick general update for an important fix.

🪔Shrine: Build Contest Winners

This one was very interesting! We had many extremely competitive entries, leading to multiple ties. Sometimes, ties at higher placements can push out lower placements, but to celebrate how great the entries were, we're awarding all entries at the top 3 scoring brackets. These winning entries all averaged a score of at least 8.5 out of 10 across judges - all well deserving of the awards, IMO, so great work!

  • 1st Place: A tie!

    • @Starmarsh™, @J_, and @໓คriค! Your warp is set as Shrine1.

    • @nate! Your warp is set as Shrine2.

  • 2nd Place: Another tie!

    • @J1mbers! Your warp is set as Shrine3.

    • @Maidl, @TroyTheCrafter, @Shotdown01, and @Hollow! Your warp is set as Shrine4.

  • 3rd Place:

    • @beccc! Your warp is set as Shrine5.

Thanks so much to everyone who entered. Your prize money has been distributed (split evenly where necessary), your prize items are in a bundle in the submitter's ender chest (Star, Maidl, and ElectricSparx for the joint entries), and as usual the winners may request a free warp rename if desired.

The winners will additionally find one Sanguine Phial🩸charm per entrant in their award bundle. This charm heals you on combat exit based on the number of enemies slain. If you slayed many enemies that combat, you will additionally be granted a reward from a small loot pool - spoils of war from the god of war himself!

General Update

The crossbow form of Aphelion of Pluto should now behave properly with Bolt-action and should no longer disappear when trying to swap it while not wearing the Aphelion. Apologies for everyone this burned!

🫶
